import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu'; import { Fn, If, instancedArray, instanceIndex, float } from 'three/tsl'; window.runExample = async function() { const output = document.getElementById('output'); output.innerHTML = 'Initializing...'; try { const renderer = new THREE.WebGPURenderer(); await renderer.init(); output.innerHTML = '✓ WebGPU ready\n'; // Input: various numbers const inputData = new Float32Array([-5, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 5, -100, 100]); const outputData = new Float32Array(inputData.length); output.innerHTML += `\nInput values: [${Array.from(inputData).join(', ')}]\n`; // Create buffers const inputBuffer = instancedArray(inputData, 'float'); const outputBuffer = instancedArray(outputData, 'float'); // Compute shader: classify as -1, 0, or 1 const classify = Fn(() => { const value = inputBuffer.element(instanceIndex); // Create a mutable result variable const result = float(0); If(value.lessThan(0), () => { result.assign(-1); }).ElseIf(value.greaterThan(0), () => { result.assign(1); }); // If value === 0, result stays 0 outputBuffer.element(instanceIndex).assign(result); })().compute(inputData.length); // Execute await renderer.computeAsync(classify); // Read results const resultBuffer = await renderer.getArrayBufferAsync(outputBuffer.value); const results = new Float32Array(resultBuffer); output.innerHTML += '\nClassification results:\n'; for (let i = 0; i < inputData.length; i++) { const sign = results[i] === -1 ? 'negative' : results[i] === 1 ? 'positive' : 'zero'; output.innerHTML += ` ${inputData[i].toString().padStart(5)} → ${results[i].toString().padStart(2)} (${sign})\n`; } output.innerHTML += '\n✓ All numbers classified correctly!'; renderer.dispose(); } catch (error) { output.innerHTML += `\n✗ Error: ${error.message}`; console.error(error); } };
